# Revision-2 HPC experiments — summary (auto-generated by `scripts/revision2_hpc_analysis.py`)

All numbers below are computed from the per-task JSON/NPZ outputs in this folder and the committed headline result files; see the script header for the statistics. CIs are paired-t 95%; p are two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank; r_rb = matched-pairs rank-biserial; 'reversals' = animals whose sign opposes the mean.

## 1. Leakage ladder at the stated recipe (R1.M2, R1.M3, R3.M1, R3.M2)

Recipe: accel-only STA-LSTM-H (`build_model('lstm_h', 14)`, same model as the original ladder), Adam 2e-3, wd 1e-4, clip 1.2, **batch 64, 40 epochs, multi-task MSE+0.35·CE with the real pseudo-position target**, weighted CE (audit_class_balance on the training partition), z-score on the training partition. XGBoost (trainer._eval_xgboost hyper-parameters, unweighted) run on the same splits. Per-animal value = mean over folds; n = 18 animals.
